facts.en: Earned a chemistry diploma at Fictional Brookflint College in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构溪燧学院获得化学文凭。

facts.en: Paid sample reception clerk at Fictional Reedwater Laboratory from 2018-09 to 2021-04.
facts.zh: 2018-09 至 2021-04 在虚构芦水实验室任有薪样品接收文员。

facts.en: Paid report production coordinator at the same laboratory from 2021-05 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-05 至 2026-08 在同一实验室任有薪报告制作协调员。

facts.en: Assembles environmental testing reports from analyst-approved result tables and authorized report templates.
facts.zh: 依据分析员批准的结果表及获授权报告模板编制环境检测报告。

facts.en: Checks sample identifiers, units and attached method references against the approved result package.
facts.zh: 依据获批结果资料核对样品编号、单位及所附方法编号。

facts.en: Flags missing approvals or inconsistent template fields to the technical reviewer rather than selecting substitute values.
facts.zh: 将缺失审批或不一致模板字段标记给技术审核人员，不自行选择替代数值。

facts.en: The authorized signatory approves technical interpretation and releases the final laboratory report.
facts.zh: 授权签字人批准技术解释，并发布最终实验室报告。

facts.en: Helped refresh a report-assembly checklist in 2025-01 with the quality coordinator.
facts.zh: 2025-01 与质量协调员共同协助更新报告编制核对表。

facts.en: Personally tested the revised checklist against 16 fictional report packages and recorded unclear field instructions.
facts.zh: 个人使用 16 套虚构报告资料测试修订核对表，并记录不清晰字段说明。

facts.en: A separate 2025-03 tracking log contained 52 draft reports: 45 awaiting signatory review and 7 returned for missing attachments.
facts.zh: 另一份 2025-03 跟踪日志包含 52 份报告草稿：45 份待签字人审核，7 份因缺少附件退回。

facts.en: The log does not state that the 45 pending reports were subsequently released or that the 7 returns involved analytical errors.
facts.zh: 该日志未说明 45 份待审报告后来已发布，亦未说明 7 份退回报告涉及分析错误。

facts.en: Uses a laboratory report portal, controlled Word templates and spreadsheet release-status logs.
facts.zh: 使用实验室报告门户、受控 Word 模板及电子表格发布状态日志。

facts.en: Completed an internal report traceability workshop in 2022-03.
facts.zh: 2022-03 完成内部报告可追溯性工作坊。

facts.en: Keeps superseded drafts separate from authorized final files and records requested administrative corrections.
facts.zh: 将被替代草稿与获授权最终文件分开保存，并记录所请求的行政性更正。

facts.en: Answers report-status enquiries using confirmed workflow states and routes result-interpretation questions to the technical team.
facts.zh: 使用已确认流程状态回答报告进度询问，并将结果解释问题转交技术团队。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Mallowink Nature Club, formatting meeting notes and collecting activity sign-ups.
facts.zh: 在虚构锦葵墨自然社做志愿者，排版会议记录并收集活动报名。

facts.en: Designed a personal booklet of fictional mineral illustrations in 2024 for a hobby display.
facts.zh: 2024 年为爱好展示设计个人虚构矿物插画小册子。

facts.en: The booklet contained invented descriptions and was not used as scientific identification guidance.
facts.zh: 该小册子包含虚构描述，未用作科学鉴定指南。

facts.en: Enjoys paper marbling and designing geometric book covers.
facts.zh: 爱好制作纸张水拓画及设计几何书封。

facts.en: Prepares daily handovers listing missing attachments, technical-review questions and confirmed release dates.
facts.zh: 准备每日交接，列明缺失附件、技术审核问题及已确认发布日期。
